site.name: Media
site.what: The public media library behind every site: recorded streams, clips, images and uploads.

liveness.means: the process answers and reads its apps table and active recordings (a database failure makes it fail); storage and the Network key are what /api/ready checks

drains: recordings stopped: ffmpeg gets SIGINT to write its trailer, then SIGTERM after VOD_STOP_GRACE_MS (60 s)
storage tiering, health scan, copy verification, media_jobs worker and owner-subject jobs stopped
JWKS refresh stopped, event relay reset, timers cleared
HTTP server closed, then the database

resumes.what: media_jobs left running are retried (attempts left) or failed; failed clip cuts are re-cut with auto-retry
recordings left is_recording with no ffmpeg are finalized from what reached the disk (a vod.finalize job, or once at boot without the job worker)
unsent media events in the outbox go to OpenVibe.Events; search documents resume
OpenVibe.Events redelivers network.user.token_valid_after that were pending during the stop (at least once, deduped by event_id)

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart (60 s in host.example.json); manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies
blockers: media_jobs was rebuilt once into the app_id shape (server/db/database.js migrateJobsTable): releases from before it predate that table

claims.what: a media_jobs row while its handler runs
claims.holder: the Media process that claimed it (status running, lease_token = its claim's random token)
claims.expires: lease_until = claim + 120 s, renewed while the handler runs; once it has run out, recovery requeues or fails the job, fenced on the token it read
claims.fencing: lease_token: a claim writes a fresh random token; renew, checkpoint, succeed, fail and cancel must match job id and token, so a holder that lost the job is refused (logged, counted in media_job_stale_completions_total) and its heartbeat aborts the handler
